Active monsoon conditions are expected to continue across Peninsular India under the influence of two low-pressure systems, according to Srikanth of COMK. Tamil Nadu may experience widespread rainfall today and tomorrow as the low-pressure area off the Kerala coast gradually weakens while moving across Peninsular India. The evolving weather system is likely to sustain rainy conditions across several parts of the state over the next two days.
